title: Preventive Maintenance Agreements — Adjustment Where Written Condition Reports Are Owed at Renewal
content:
## Training sheet: the report adjustment

An adjustment is earned against the price of a further term of a Preventive Maintenance Agreements record where the office owes the owner written condition reports. The reading is the preventive visits completed on the agreement against the written condition reports issued for preventive visits on it.

| Preventive visits completed carrying no written condition report | Adjustment earned |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | the repeat report adjustment, 300.00 USD |
| exactly 1 | the single report adjustment, 140.00 USD |
| none — every preventive visit completed in the term carries a written condition report | no adjustment |

### Notes and worked count (hypothetical)

- The adjustment is the single figure the count selects, subtracted once; it is not a figure per missing report.
- An agreement with 6 completed preventive visits and 4 written condition reports issued for preventive visits has 2 completed preventive visits carrying no report, so the repeat report adjustment of 300.00 USD is earned.
- The same agreement with 5 reports issued has exactly 1 completed preventive visit carrying no report, so the single report adjustment of 140.00 USD is earned.
- At a tier that includes no written condition report, no completed preventive visit carries an outstanding report and no adjustment is earned.
